title: Lundey deployment diagram
description: How Lundey is set to run: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets on the route icelander.net/games/lundey*, behind icelander.net's sign-in for holders of the invite-only role games:lundey. No database, no Durable Object, no secrets. The browser runs the whole game; the Worker only serves the files. The owner deploys it by hand with npm run deploy (delivery.json).

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the game itself, one player per device, and keeps the best score and the sound setting in its localStorage.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on the route icelander.net/games/lundey* and holds the static assets from ./dist.

nodes.name: lundey Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts, run first for every request (run_worker_first): checks the sign-in and the role, then serves the file from the assets.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: In the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the site_session cookie and their games: roles, asked on every request through a service binding. It must know the role games:lundey before anyone can hold it.

artifacts.name: game.js
artifacts.description: esbuild bundle of src/main.ts, minified; served as a static asset and run in the browser.

artifacts.name: index.html, lundey.css, icon.svg, _headers
artifacts.description: Copied from public/ into dist/games/lundey/, with _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy) moved to the root of dist/.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler and vendor/icelander-auth, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS, GET and HEAD only: the page, game.js, the styles and the icon.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): every file needs a signed-in player holding games:lundey.
